info.title: Weather API
info.description:
The API between the weather app and its clients: a backend for frontend over Open-Meteo (forecast, air quality, place search), MeteoAlarm (official warnings), Nominatim (the place at coordinates) and ipwho.is (a city from the IP address).

Every answer is JSON. Errors share one shape (ApiError) and are never cached. Temperatures are °C, wind km/h, times local to the place.

Within /api/v1 only compatible changes are made (an optional field, a new endpoint, a new error code); a breaking change gets a new prefix. Requests are limited per IP address (429, with Retry-After); near a provider's free limit new data is refused for everyone (503) while cached answers still come.

Not described here, being operations rather than the contract: GET /api/health, /api/health/quota and /api/health/notify (uptime monitors), GET /api/internal/metrics and POST /api/internal/alerts/notify (a bearer secret each); see docs/operations.md.

Generated from the zod schemas in @weather/shared (npm run openapi); do not edit by hand.

get.description: Current conditions, yesterday, the next 24 hours and the days ahead in one answer. Cached by the server (see docs/architecture.md, "Key parameters") and sent with Cache-Control. Past the cache's time a stale answer is sent at once with a short max-age while it refreshes; if the provider is down, the last good one for up to an hour.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180); the server rounds to 2 decimals (~1 km).

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Days of daily forecast, today included (1 to 16; accuracy drops after 10).

post.summary: Subscribe or unsubscribe a device's push token to warnings for a place
post.description: The server works out the MeteoAlarm areas the place belongs to and subscribes the token to their topics (one per area, kind of warning and minimum level) in Firebase Cloud Messaging; the token itself is not stored. Only with push configured on the server: otherwise the endpoint does not exist (404). Changes are limited per token (120 an hour) and by a global Firebase budget, which unsubscribing is exempt from; the per-IP request limit applies to both.

token.description: The device's Firebase Cloud Messaging registration token.

latitude.description: Of the place to watch, decimal degrees.

longitude.description: Of the place to watch, decimal degrees.

group.description: Which warnings: "storm" (wind and thunderstorms) or "all" types.

subscribe.description: true to subscribe the token to the place, false to unsubscribe it.

400.description: A parameter or the body is missing or out of range (INVALID_REQUEST); the message names it.

404.description: Push notifications are not configured on this server (NOT_FOUND).

429.description: Too many requests from this address, or more than 120 changes an hour for this token (RATE_LIMITED); the per-token limit does not apply to unsubscribing. Wait for Retry-After.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the address may try again.

RateLimit.description: The allowance and what is left of it (IETF draft-8), when a request limit answered.

502.description: Firebase did not accept the change (PROVIDER_ERROR); the device may retry.

503.description: The Firebase budget for subscription changes is spent (SERVICE_BUSY); try later.

default.description: Any other error, in the same shape.

post.summary: An error from a user's browser, for the server log
post.description: The web app sends render errors and uncaught errors here, a few per page at most; there is no error-tracking service. Logged as a warning, never answered with the details.

kind.description: "render": a component failed to render; "error": an uncaught error; "rejection": an unhandled promise rejection.

stack.description: The stack trace, when there is one.

componentStack.description: Which components a render error happened in (React gives it).

path.description: The page, with places replaced by a placeholder: no coordinates reach the logs.

release.description: The build that failed: the service worker may keep an old one in use for a while.

id.description: GeoNames id: identifies the place in city URLs and in GET /locations/{id}.

name.description: In the requested language where the provider has it, else in English.

country.description: Country name, in the requested language where available.

areas.description: Levels below the region, most general first (province, district, municipality); "" where a level is missing, so positions line up across places. Tells same-named places apart.

kind.description: What the place is when it is not a town; clients ignore kinds they do not know.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the place, e.g. "Europe/Warsaw".

Location.description: A place from the search geocoder.

locations.description: Best matches first; empty when nothing matched.

time.description: Local time at the place, "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm" (no offset). The current hour.

windGusts.description: Gust speed, in the same unit; absent in forecasts cached before the field existed.

windDirection.description: Direction the wind blows from, degrees (0 = north).

weatherCode.description: WMO weather interpretation code (0 clear sky … 99 thunderstorm with hail).

isDay.description: Whether it is daytime at the place now.

CurrentWeather.description: The current hour at the place.

weatherCode.description: WMO weather interpretation code for the day.

precipitationProbability.description: Highest chance of precipitation in the day, %; null when unknown.

sunrise.description: Local time at the place, "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm" (no offset). Null in polar day or night; absent in answers cached before the field existed.

sunset.description: Local time at the place, "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm" (no offset). Null in polar day or night; absent in older answers.

time.description: Local time at the place, "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm" (no offset).

windGusts.description: Gust speed, in the same unit.

weatherCode.description: WMO weather interpretation code for the hour.

precipitationProbability.description: Chance of precipitation, %; null when unknown.

precipitation.description: Expected amount in the hour, in Forecast.units.precipitation (mm).

isDay.description: Whether the hour is in daylight.

latitude.description: The point the forecast is for: the request rounded to 2 decimals (~1 km).

longitude.description: The point the forecast is for: the request rounded to 2 decimals (~1 km).

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the place; every time in the answer is local to it.

units.description: Units of the numbers in this answer, as the provider names them.

yesterday.description: Yesterday's weather at the place, for comparison; null when the provider has none.

hourly.description: The next 24 hours, starting with the current hour.

daily.description: One per day, starting with today in the place's time zone.

code.description: What went wrong, for the client to act on: INVALID_REQUEST (400): a parameter or body is missing or out of range; the message names it. NOT_FOUND (404): no such place, or no such endpoint. RATE_LIMITED (429): this address sent too many requests, or asked for too many new places; Retry-After says when to try again. PROVIDER_ERROR (502): the data provider did not answer or answered wrongly; worth a retry in a minute. SERVICE_BUSY (503): the server is near a provider's free limit for everyone; cached data is still served, new places wait. INTERNAL (500): our bug. NETWORK_ERROR: made by the client only when no answer came; never sent by the API.

message.description: Plain English, safe to show to the user; clients translate by code where they can.

error.description: What went wrong: a code to act on and a message to show.

ApiError.description: The one shape of every error answer; errors are never cached.

forecasts.description: In the order the places were asked for: the forecast, or the error for that place alone (the others still come).

time.description: Local time at the place, "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm" (no offset). The hour the values are for.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the place, used to pick the index people there know.

europeanAqi.description: European Air Quality Index (0–20 good … over 100 extremely poor); null where the provider has no data.

usAqi.description: US AQI (0–50 good … over 300 hazardous); null where the provider has no data.

AirQuality.description: Current air quality at a place.

name.description: City or locality, in the requested language where available.

latitude.description: The matched city's coordinates when id is set, so it is the same place as in search; else the point asked for.

id.description: GeoNames id, when the place matched a city the search knows.

ReversePlace.description: What to call a place found by coordinates or by IP address.

id.description: The warning's CAP identifier; stable for one warning.

level.description: MeteoAlarm awareness level: yellow (2), orange (3) or red (4); green is never sent.

type.description: MeteoAlarm awareness type (CAP profile v2.0); "other" for anything new.

onset.description: ISO 8601 with offset; the warning is in force from onset to expires.

language.description: Language of the texts (BCP 47, e.g. "pl-PL"): the requested one if the issuer has it, else English.

event.description: The issuer's own name for the event, unmodified.

sender.description: The national weather service that issued it.

web.description: URL of the issuer's page about this kind of warning.

WeatherAlert.description: One official warning, in the words of the national weather service.

alerts.description: Most severe first, then soonest; empty where there are none or no coverage.

attribution.description: Who to credit next to the warnings, as the source's terms require; null when nothing is shown.

name.description: The credit line to show, e.g. "EUMETNET – MeteoAlarm".

covered.description: Whether the source covers the place at all (false outside Europe), so warnings and notifications can exist there. Absent in answers cached before the field existed.

areas.description: The MeteoAlarm areas the place belongs to; the service worker matches incoming warnings by them.
